transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because I’m just tired all the time. It's getting really hard to push through the day. By midmorning at work, after just reviewing some files or, you know, walking a junior adjuster through a claim, it feels like my body and my brain are already running on empty. I just don't have any energy left.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

Yeah, I have. Most days it just feels like there’s a... a gray film over everything. Even when things are good, like when my husband is being kind or we’re cooking with the family, I just kind of go through the motions. I don't really feel the enjoyment I used to.
Do you wake up feeling rested?
No, not really. Um... most mornings I wake up feeling just as tired as when I went to sleep. It's like the sleep doesn't even do anything, you know? I just start the day already exhausted.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly when you sleep?
No, my husband hasn't ever mentioned anything like that. Um... I don't think I do. At least, not loud enough to bother him or for him to bring it up to me.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?

No, not really. Um... I mean, I have the normal day-to-day stress, but I wouldn't say I've been worrying a lot. It's not really an anxious feeling or my mind racing with worries. It's more just... like I said, feeling flat and exhausted all the time. So, no, not really any extra worrying.
How long have you been feeling this down and exhausted?

Well, it's been quite a while now. I'd say it's been going on for about three years and three months. It started right around the time I was moved into a role with a lot more responsibility at work. I had to start mentoring the newer adjusters and overseeing all the new workflow systems we were putting in place. So, yeah, it's been pretty much ever since then.
Do you feel your low mood and exhaustion are mainly because of the increased responsibilities at work?

Well, I'm not really sure if it's just the work. I mean, the responsibilities definitely increased, and that was stressful at first. But... I don't know, it just feels like it's become my normal state now. Even when work isn't too crazy, I still feel this way. So, I guess I can't say for certain it's mainly because of the job.
Before these past three years, had you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for weeks or longer?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I felt sad for a few days here or there, like anyone else, but nothing like this. This is the first time it's just... stuck around like this for so long. Before three years ago, I generally had decent energy and felt pretty normal.
Have you gained weight without trying to over the past few years?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My weight has stayed pretty much the same over the last few years.
Do you wake up a lot during the night?
No, not really. I mean, maybe once in a while like anyone else, but for the most part, I sleep straight through. Waking up during the night hasn't really been an issue for me.
Are you sleeping more hours than usual?

No, I don't think I'm sleeping more than usual. I usually get about seven or eight hours, and that hasn't really changed. I'm just tired during the day, but the actual hours I sleep at night are about the same.
Has your husband ever noticed that you stop breathing in your sleep?
No, he's never mentioned anything like that. As far as I know, I breathe just fine during the night.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty a lot lately?
No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I don't really feel worthless... and I don't have anything to feel guilty about. So, no, those aren't really things I've been dealing with.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Not really, no. I mean, my job involves looking at a lot of details and reports all day, and I haven't had any problems focusing on that. So my concentration seems to be fine.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I don't want to hurt myself, and I definitely don't think about... well, ending things or anything. I just feel down a lot, but I'm not having those kinds of thoughts.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
No, not that I've noticed. I mean, I feel like I'm moving and talking at my regular pace. Nobody at work or at home has said anything about me being slower, so... no, I don't think so.
Have you had a decreased appetite lately?
No, my appetite has been pretty normal. I eat about the same amount I usually do, so I haven't noticed any changes there.
Have you been feeling unusually sensitive to cold lately?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I keep the thermostat about where I always do, and I'm not bundling up more than usual. So, no, the cold hasn't been bothering me any differently.
Do you often wake up earlier than you want to and can’t get back to sleep?
No, my sleep is mostly fine in that regard. I wake up when my alarm goes off for work, but I don't find myself waking up super early and just laying there.
Have you had less interest in sex lately?
No, not really. Things are pretty much the same in that department, so I haven't noticed any changes there either.
